Framework rule: one signal alone is noise, two is a watch, three or more across different families is an edge. Confirmed = 3 straight sessions in zone. Rejected signals and the checklist rows are not counted here.
How to read each row: the bar shows how far the metric has travelled toward its trigger, 100% means it is right at the firing point. Red = a bear signal firing, green = a bull signal firing, amber = forming, faint = quiet. Getting closer tells you if the gap is still shrinking. How often is the share of the last 3 years this condition was ON: the rarer it fires, the louder it is.

Statuses recompute nightly from the EOD pipeline. Confirmed = 3 consecutive sessions in zone (the framework buffer rule: one day in zone is noise). In formation = consecutive sessions spent in the top quintile of the metric. Sources: Polygon cache, nightly signal history tables, Yahoo for index series, FRED for macro. Grey rows are conditions Kerberos tracked that we cannot source yet; they stay listed so the catalog remains complete. Our own backtest verdicts live inside each row's detail.
